AckCode.description:
Stable dispatch/ack vocabulary (plan §6.4).  Values are part of the
serialized contract — never rename them.
AckCode.title: AckCode

AdmissionDecision.description:
Outcome of one admission-chain traversal (plan §6.4): a stable code
plus human detail.  ``task_id`` is set when a run was created/queued.
AdmissionDecision.title: AdmissionDecision

ApiEnvelope.description:
Every ``/api/v1`` response body.  Clients branch on ``status`` for
coarse UI (toast/banner) and on the typed payload inside ``data`` for
logic — the envelope itself carries zero domain semantics.
ApiEnvelope.title: ApiEnvelope

ApiError.description:
One transport-level failure: HTTP status mirror + stable code +
human detail (never parsed).  ``info`` attributes device/kernel errors
when one caused the failure.
ApiError.title: ApiError

ApiErrorCode.description:
Transport-level failure vocabulary.  Values are part of the serialized
contract — never rename them.
ApiErrorCode.title: ApiErrorCode

BundleFileEntry.description: One file in the archive, as declared by the manifest.
BundleFileEntry.title: BundleFileEntry

BundleIssue.description: One preflight finding: a stable machine code + human detail.
BundleIssue.title: BundleIssue

BundleManifest.description: ``manifest.json`` — the archive's single source of truth.
BundleManifest.title: BundleManifest

BundlePreflight.description:
Read-only import plan (lessons §6.2): what would be admitted, reused,
or rejected — produced without extracting, importing, or touching any
device.
BundlePreflight.title: BundlePreflight

CalibrationAsset.description: Immutable calibration artifact with provenance + applicability.
CalibrationAsset.title: CalibrationAsset

ControllerStats.description: Operational state for device panels / the future API (plan §3.1 A2).
ControllerStats.title: ControllerStats

DeviceStatusView.description:
One device-table row for panels/clients: static config + live
lifecycle + operational stats, assembled by the device service.
DeviceStatusView.title: DeviceStatusView

EnvironmentRequirement.description: A logical device the profile needs — re-bound on the target machine.
EnvironmentRequirement.title: EnvironmentRequirement

ErrorCode.description:
Stable machine-readable error classes for the wire (plan §6.4).

Values are part of the serialized contract — never rename them.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorInfo.description:
Structured error attached to acks and events (plan §6.4): clients read
``code`` and ``instrument_id``; ``message`` is human detail only.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

EventBusStats.description:
Bus health counters (plan §6.5): published to diagnostics consumers
instead of living only in process memory.
EventBusStats.title: EventBusStats

ExperimentProfile.description: Reproducible experiment parameters for one plugin command.
ExperimentProfile.title: ExperimentProfile

ImageThumbnail.description:
Tiny raster thumbnail (SLM mask, camera frame); PNG, base64-encoded.
The length cap keeps the event under the bus byte ceiling.
ImageThumbnail.title: ImageThumbnail

JournalRecordType.description:
Lifecycle facts, in causal order (plan §6.2).  ``RECOVERED`` is
appended by the startup scan when a journal ends without ``FINALIZED``.
JournalRecordType.title: JournalRecordType

LogEvent.description: Short log excerpt for live UI consoles (full log goes to experiment.jsonl).
LogEvent.title: LogEvent

PluginManifest.description:
Static facts about one plugin (``plugin.toml`` for directory plugins;
derived from the class for builtins).
PluginManifest.title: PluginManifest

PluginStatusView.description: One row of the plugin availability report (A8).
PluginStatusView.title: PluginStatusView

RecoveryReport.description:
One incomplete run explained by the startup scan (plan §6.2): what the
journal proves happened, and what the operator should conclude.
RecoveryReport.title: RecoveryReport

RunDraft.description: A profile resolved against this machine: unexecuted by definition.
RunDraft.title: RunDraft

RunResult.description:
Catalog row: one line per run, queryable without opening run dirs.
``state`` is the last known interactive state or a recovery resolution.
RunResult.title: RunResult

ScalarSeries.description: Named scalar-vs-x series (optimizer metric history, power monitor).
ScalarSeries.title: ScalarSeries

ServerMeta.description:
``GET /api/v1/meta`` — capability discovery + version pinning (A14).

``static_ui`` reports the dist cascade: ``ok`` (pinned versions match),
``outdated`` (older dist served with a warning), ``refused`` (newer than
the backend or unreadable pin — not served), ``absent``.
ServerMeta.title: ServerMeta

SpectrumPreview.description: Down-sampled preview small enough for the bus; cap is part of the schema.
SpectrumPreview.title: SpectrumPreview
